name: rug of smothering
lore:
Imagine stepping into a grand hall, the air thick with the scent of dust and forgotten ages. Your feet sink slightly into a plush rug, its intricate patterns a tapestry of faded colors. Unbeknownst to you, this seemingly innocuous furnishing is a rug of smothering, a silent predator lurking beneath the guise of comfort. As you admire the architecture, the rug stirs, its edges rising ever so slightly, like a serpent awakening from its slumber. 

With alarming speed, the rug unfurls, its purpose revealed. It lunges, enveloping you in its suffocating embrace. The air is forced from your lungs as the rug tightens its grip, its coarse fibers pressing against your skin. Panic sets in as you realize the beautiful rug is not merely a decoration, but a cunning trap, eager to claim you as its next victim. Your struggle is met with an implacable force, as the rug continues to constrict, stealing your breath and crushing your hope.
